FORM.SUMMARY: You can add awards for players who are associated with the season. If you have an award that is not associated with a player, you can add it as a comment so it will be displayed in the season awards summary.

HELPERS.VALUE: Use this field to assign a value to the award. This can be used for awards that have a numeric value such as most goals etc.

ADD_AWARD.ERROR: There was an error adding the award. Please try again.

EDIT_AWARD.ERROR: There was an error updating the award. Please try again.

VALIDATION.NAME_MAX: Award name must be at most 50 characters
